thread.title: Apple completes Shazam buy, bringing ad-free version to all users - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Apple completes Shazam buy, bringing ad-free version to all users - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) completes its acquisition of Shazam, weeks after receiving EU approval.
To celebrate, Apple will soon make the music discovery app ad-free for all users.
Shazam has been downloaded over 1B times around the world and users identify songs through the app over 20M times each day.
